messages:
maya: heads-up, nebula9b-ptq onboarding is flaking our qa/eval CI. SQuAD runs show answer spans shifted by a few tokens, metric drop ~12% vs baseline. failing job: https://ci.redwood/12345 :frowning:

maya: repro command: `./run_eval.py --model nebula9b-ptq --suite qa.squad --split dev --seed 42`

ci-bot: CI job failed: eval-harness/qa-squad (nebula9b-ptq) — exit 1 — logs: https://ci.redwood/12345/logs

sanjay: did you try running with the same tokenizer as the model artifact? sometimes PTQ builds swap token ids.

maya: yes, using artifacts/nebula9b-ptq/tokenizer.json from model registry. Token counts match but offsets differ. quick inspect shows weird extra 0-byte tokens before sentences.

lucas: can you paste a short failing example?

maya: repro snippet:
```
Question: "Who wrote The Odyssey?"
Context: "Homer is credited with composing the epic poem The Odyssey."
Expected answer span: "Homer"
Model tokenized span: "\u0000Homer"
```

eva: that leading null byte looks like a byte-level BPE artifact + our collate logic not stripping prefix sentinel when building token offsets for answers. We saw similar with calypso7b but different cause.

sanjay: I recall a runner change that tried to preserve prefix bytes for kv-cache alignment. Might be the collate->offset mapping: we compute char offsets from tokenization but forget to account for special prefix tokens when quantized model uses a different pad/id mapping.

lucas: digging into eval-runner collate: in `batcher.py:prepare_qa_targets` we do `start = token_to_char[start_id]` but token_to_char assumes trimmed inputs. If kv-padding inserted a 0 at token index 0, indexes shift. Patch idea: compute token->char mapping after removing special prefix tokens and expose a `token_index_delta` used for all answer mapping.

maya: repro with patched local change (hacky) fixed the sample. ran local eval, EM jumped back to baseline.

eva: can you share the minimal patch? I'll open a PR and run CI with nebula9b-ptq matrix.

lucas: minimal fix we tested locally (pseudo):
```
# in batcher.py
# strip leading prefix tokens that are non-printing when building mapping
while tokens and tokens[0] in SPECIAL_PREFIX_IDS:
    tokens.pop(0)
    token_to_char = recompute_mapping(tokens)
```

sanjay: small nit: we should avoid mutating the original token list (other parts rely on raw indexes). instead compute an offset: `prefix_len = count_prefix(tokens); mapping = build_mapping(tokens[prefix_len:]); final_index = raw_index - prefix_len`. less risky.

maya: +1 for non-mutating. i'll test that variant now.

ci-bot: Job queued: eval-harness/nebula9b-ptq-patch (run 2) — https://ci.redwood/12346

maya: also seeing metric drift in dashboard — route: /dash/evals/qa/nebula9b-ptq — shows tokenization mismatch warnings in the ingest logs. attaching snippet of the ingest log:
```
WARN ingest: token_offset_mismatch sample_id=4521 model=nebula9b-ptq tokens_before=[0,12,45] tokens_after=[12,45]
```

eva: thats the same indicator. will add a sanity check in the runner to emit a clearer error and fail-fast in CI (so we don't misreport degraded metrics).

lucas: quick triage plan:
- add non-mutating prefix-offset handling in batcher
- add unit test around token->char mapping for cases with leading null/zero tokens
- add CI matrix job to run eval against both float and PTQ artifacts for any new model onboarding PRs
- add dashboard alert for token_offset_mismatch > 1%

sanjay: for immediate unblock, maya can we mark nebula9b-ptq onboarding as "hold: token_offsets" in model-registry to stop auto-rollouts?

maya: done — put hold with note: "offsets mismatch in eval harness; investigating"

eva: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness/pull/4810 — includes tests + fix + CI matrix. assigning reviewers.

maya: thanks all. will follow up after CI run. if anyone hits similar symptoms for other PTQ models, ping here and we'll correlate. :thumbsup:
